description: ABBYNormal calculates lower-ionosphere electron density using ionisation sources and simplified chemistry. Its D- and E-region calculations support assessment of high-frequency radio absorption. The resource is documented by CASS USU. The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The catalogue lists this version as retired; the documentation does not establish a currently supported service. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
